Job Title: Oracle OSB/AIA Developer 
 Location: Atlanta, GA
 Duration: Fulltime 
 
 
 . 
 
 OSB/AIA JD : 
 Experienced SME who has knowledge and skills in Oracle Service Bus(OSB), Oracle AIA and WebLogic server. SME will be part of the integration development team who will design and deliver functionalities related to Integration platform based on the requirements. 
 
 Experience with performance troubleshooting and tuning of the Oracle Stack (OSB mainly and AIA ) 
 Good knowledge of administrations consoles used for monitoring and management of the mentioned Oracle stack 
 Must have experience of implementing such solution in at least 1 E2E System Integration project in Telecom 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
